canonical_project: Arunachal Pradesh State Data Centre (SDC), Civil Secretariat, Itanagar
owner: Department of IT & Communication, Government of Arunachal Pradesh (NIC-supported)
notes: Official DITC page lists the State Data Centre at Block 1, 1st Floor, Room 107, Civil Secretariat, Itanagar (Papum Pare district), hosting common infrastructure: UPS power, cooling, rack space, security, storage, monitoring and Internet. TOI reported CM Pema Khandu inaugurated the SDC (Mar 2024), described as facilitating high-end data services for government. Capacity MW not publicly disclosed; state-level government DC, not commercial colocation.
